title: Standard (skeleton)
description: A blank standard with the sections a standard cannot be approved without: purpose, scope and requirements.

facts.label: Parent policy
facts.description: The policy this document implements, by title and reference.

facts.label: Document owner role
facts.description: The role accountable for this document.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: This standard sets out the specific, measurable requirements that implement {{fact:parent_policy_reference}}.
sections.guidance: Name the policy requirement this standard makes specific.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.content: This standard applies to the systems, information and people in scope of {{fact:parent_policy_reference}}, unless an exclusion is recorded here with its justification.
sections.guidance: Narrow the parent policy's scope if this standard covers less of it.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.content:
1. Each requirement in this standard must be specific, measurable and testable.
2. The {{fact:document_owner_role}} must be able to show how each requirement is met.
sections.guidance: A standard is where technology-bound detail belongs: settings, versions, thresholds. Every value that depends on the client is a fact.
